messages:
zoe (Marketing): Putting together copy for the 'Clockwork' release. Target publish Thu 09:00am PT. Need final changelog, canonical docs link, a 1-paragraph bench blurb and 3 bullets for slides by EOD Wed.
dev (Engineering): Working on changelog now. Will add canary rollout plan, rollback CLI, and the reserved-capacity migration snippet.
maria (Docs): I can spin up /docs/clockwork-release after the PR merges. Please include example config and a short migration checklist in the changelog PR so I can copy it.
kevin (Product): Webinar scheduled Fri 10am PT. Marketing needs a short teaser for the registration and a 3-bullet bench highlight. Also confirm the lead webhook for registrants.
zoe (Marketing): For the teaser we want ~25-30 words. Bench blurb should call out latency and unit-cost improvements.
dev (Engineering): Draft bench para: "Clockwork improves median decode latency by ~24% on 8k contexts and cuts per-token inference cost by ~27% thanks to improved batching rules and quant kernels. Optional prefix caching boosts hot-session p95."
dev (Engineering): Bullets: 1) ~24% median latency improvement (8k), 2) ~27% per-token cost reduction with batching+quant, 3) prefix-cache option for stable p95 on hot sessions.
maria (Docs): I'll publish the page and post the canonical URL here as soon as it's live. Aim to avoid linking to staging previews.
infra-bot: Docs deploy scheduled: clockwork -> staging at 2026-04-10T04:00:00Z.
zoe (Marketing): Great. Dev, can you shorten the paragraph to ~30 words for the promo and hand the bullets here? Also add the Dedicated migration example to the changelog so Docs can publish.
dev (Engineering): Short promo (30w): "Clockwork trims median latency ~24% and reduces per-token cost ~27% via smarter batching and quant kernels; includes an optional prefix cache for consistent hot-session performance."
kevin (Product): For rollout timing we'll reference the 3-hour staged canary in the post. Dev, paste the canary window and rollback command in the changelog PR.
dev (Engineering): Will do.
zoe (Marketing): Thanks everyone 680680. I'll lock the post draft tonight and wait for the docs URL + webhook before scheduling the publish.
